**Requirements:**

- [ ] The nominee has met all requirements to be a Maintainer, as outlined in the [contributor ladder](https://github.com/agentgateway/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTOR_LADDER.md#maintainer)
- [ ] I have added the nominee to the list of active maintainers in [MAINTAINERS.md](https://github.com/agentgateway/community/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md)
- [ ] At least 2 current Maintainers from each relevant repository have approved this PR
- [ ] The nominee has added a comment to this PR testifying that they agree to the requirements of becoming a Maintainer, e.g. `I agree to all of the responsibilities and requirements of being an agentgateway Maintainer`.
- [ ] There are no objections from other maintainers after either leaving the PR open for one week or asking at the weekly community meeting whether there are any objections
